name: ownaichat-cloudflare2
description: Private multi-model AI chat on Workers + Static Assets and D1; optional R2 and Access

scripts.check: node --check src/worker.js && node --check src/access.js && node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check scripts/secrets.mjs && node --check scripts/deploy-button.mjs

DB.description: Private D1 database for chats, projects and account.

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Private first-installation token: generate with openssl rand -hex 32. Use a different value from VAULT_KEY. Never commit. May be removed after setup.

VAULT_KEY.description: Required permanent secret: 64 hex characters from openssl rand -hex 32. Back up securely; do not rotate on an existing installation.
